honest_note_on_probability: This alters a RATE, not a deterministic value. Mode A pins the dice: the two corner arms hold the accuracy die at a constant (every sub-100 move misses, or every one hits), so a change of 56.25 -> 60 cannot be seen there at all. The `middle` arm draws a live seeded value per address, so a changed accuracy can flip a hit — but only if the die lands in the gap. This is therefore predicted as a LAB-ONLY move: the census row and the two-engine probe are where it must show, and the pool is predicted UNMOVED at its point estimate.
